hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandBi.name: commandBinding
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandBi.doc: Bind a toolbar / status bar item to a command id (OverflowToolbar, StatusBar): its own `label`, `icon`, `shortcut`, `disabled` and `onSelect` override the command's. Reactive: a command registered later is picked up.
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandBi.signature: function commandBinding(item: { command?: string | undefined; label?: unknown; icon?: unknown; shortcut?: string | undefined; disabled?: unknown; onSelect?: (() => unknown) | undefined }): CommandBinding

params.name: item
params.type: { command?: string | undefined; label?: unknown; icon?: unknown; shortcut?: string | undefined; disabled?: unknown; onSelect?: (() => unknown) | undefined }

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandBi.tr: Bir araç çubuğu / durum çubuğu öğesini komut kimliğine bağlar (OverflowToolbar, StatusBar): kendi `label`, `icon`, `shortcut`, `disabled` ve `onSelect` değerleri komutunkilerin yerine geçer. Tepkisel: sonradan kaydedilen komut da alınır.

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandBu.name: CommandButton
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandBu.doc: A Button bound to a command: runs it, shows its busy state, follows `when` and `can`.

props.name: command
props.doc: Command id.

props.name: iconOnly
props.doc: Icon only (the title becomes the label and tooltip).

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandBu.tr: Bir komuta bağlı Button: komutu çalıştırır, meşgul durumunu gösterir, `when` ve `can` değerlerini izler.

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandIt.name: commandItems
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandIt.doc: Menu items from the registry (reactive accessor: commands registered later appear).
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandIt.signature: function commandItems(pick: CommandPick, args: unknown[] = []): () => MenuItemSpec[]
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandIt.tr: Kayıt defterinden menü öğeleri (tepkisel erişimci: sonradan kaydedilen komutlar görünür).

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandMe.name: commandMenuItem
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandMe.doc: One command as a menu entry (Menu, a future ContextMenu): label, icon, shortcut, disabled, hidden.
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandMe.signature: function commandMenuItem(c: Command, args: unknown[] = []): MenuItemSpec
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandMe.tr: Bir komut, menü girdisi olarak (Menu, ileride ContextMenu): label, icon, shortcut, disabled, hidden.

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandTo.name: CommandToolbar
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandTo.doc: A toolbar (button group) filled from the registry.
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandTo.tr: Kayıt defterinden doldurulan araç çubuğu (düğme grubu).

hadi-march/landing#actionButtons.name: actionButtons
hadi-march/landing#actionButtons.doc: Buttons for a list of actions (the first is primary): `sectionActions` of SectionHead with the hero's size.
hadi-march/landing#actionButtons.signature: const actionButtons: (actions: readonly (HeroAction | Node)[] | undefined, size?: "md" | "lg") => unknown[]
hadi-march/landing#actionButtons.tr: Bir eylem listesi için düğmeler (ilki birincil): Hero, CtaBand ve Pricing ortak kullanır.

hadi-march/landing#Appear.name: Appear
hadi-march/landing#Appear.doc:
Fragments: every child appears on its own step. `
  • One
  • Two
    • ` (renders a list); `effect="none"` shows a step without movement.
hadi-march/landing#Appear.signature: function Appear(props: { as?: string | undefined; effect?: "up" | "fade" | "scale" | "none" | undefined; class?: ClassProp | undefined; children?: unknown }): Element

params.name: props
params.type: { as?: string | undefined; effect?: "up" | "fade" | "scale" | "none" | undefined; class?: ClassProp | undefined; children?: unknown }

hadi-march/landing#Appear.tr:
Parçalar: her alt öğe kendi adımında belirir. `
  • Bir
  • İki
    • ` (liste çizer).

hadi-march/landing#BeforeAfter.name: BeforeAfter

props.name: before
props.doc: The first layer (start / top side): an image, a mock, any node.

props.name: after
props.doc: The second layer (end / bottom side).

props.name: value
props.doc: Divider position, 0–100 from the start (default 50).

props.name: orientation
props.doc: `horizontal`: the divider is vertical and moves across (default) · `vertical`: it moves down.

props.name: follow
props.doc: The divider follows the pointer while it is over the area (no press needed).

props.name: hint
props.doc: Sway once when first visible (default true).

props.name: ratio
props.doc: CSS aspect-ratio of the area, e.g. "16 / 9" (default: the layers' own height).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the handle (default "Before and after").

props.name: grip
props.doc: The round grip on the divider: true (default, two arrows), false (the line only), or your own node.

props.name: step
props.doc: Keyboard step of the arrow keys, in percent (default 1; Shift and Page keys move 10 steps).

props.name: valueText
props.doc: The handle's value text for screen readers (default "40% before, 60% after").

hadi-march/landing#BeforeAfter.tr: Önce / sonra karşılaştırması: `<BeforeAfter before={eski} after={yeni} beforeLabel="Önce" afterLabel="Sonra" />`; sürükle, bas, klavye ya da `follow` ile imleci izle.

hadi-march/landing#BranchingStory.name: BranchingStory
hadi-march/landing#BranchingStory.doc: `<BranchingStory start="intro" passages={{ intro: { body: "…", choices: [{ label: "Go", to: "next" }] }, next: { body: "The end", ending: "Short" } }} />`

props.name: passages
props.doc: Passages by id.

props.name: start
props.doc: Id of the first passage.

props.name: path
props.doc: The path (passage ids from the start), to restore or drive it from outside.

props.name: trail
props.doc: Show the trail of choices (default true).

props.name: endings
props.doc: Count the endings found (default true).

props.name: action
props.doc: Shown at an ending, next to "Start again" (a call to action).

props.name: minHeight
props.doc: Minimum stage height (CSS length, default "20rem"): passages of different length do not move the page.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Story").

props.name: labels
props.type: { /** Accessible name of the trail (default "Your path"). */ path?: string; /** First step of the trail (default "Start"). */ start?: unknown; endings?: (found: number, total: number) => unknown; /** Body of a passage id that does not exist. */ missing?: unknown; /** Heading of an ending without a title or a name (default "The end"). */ end?: unknown; /** Before the ending's name in its badge (default "Ending: "). */ endingPrefix?: unknown; /** The button at an ending (default "Start again"). */ restart?: unknown; } | undefined
props.doc: Every text the story writes itself; the defaults are translated. `endings` gets the found and the total count.

props.name: restart
props.doc: The "Start again" button at an ending (default true).

props.name: keys
props.doc: Number keys 1–9 pick a choice, and each choice shows its number (default true).

props.name: renderChoice
props.doc: Draw the content of a choice button yourself (the button, its key and its motion stay).

props.name: transition
props.type: "turn" | "slide" | "fade" | "none" | ((side: 1 | -1) => { leave: Record<string, unknown[]>; enter: Record<string, unknown[]>; duration?: number; easing?: string }) | undefined
props.doc: How the page changes: "turn" (default: a 3D page turn), "slide", "fade", "none", or your own keyframes for the leaving and the entering passage; `side` is 1 forward and -1 back (already mirrored in RTL).

hadi-march/landing#BranchingStory.tr: Seçimlerle ilerleyen hikâye: `<BranchingStory start="giris" passages={{ giris: { body: "…", choices: [{ label: "Devam", to: "son" }] }, son: { body: "…", ending: "Mutlu son" } }} />`.

hadi-march/landing#compareRow.name: compareRow
hadi-march/landing#compareRow.doc: How the `us` column does in a row: 1 ahead, 0 even, -1 behind, null when the row is not scored.
hadi-march/landing#compareRow.signature: function compareRow(row: CompareRow, us: string): 1 | 0 | -1 | null
hadi-march/landing#compareRow.tr: Bir karşılaştırma satırında ürünün durumu: 1 önde, 0 eşit, -1 geride, null puanlanmıyor.

hadi-march/landing#Counter.name: Counter
hadi-march/landing#Counter.doc: `<Counter value={12500} />`, `<Counter value={$price} mode="roll" format={EUR} />` (format: Intl.NumberFormat options)

props.name: from
props.doc: First value counted from (default 0).

props.name: format
props.doc: Intl.NumberFormat options (currency, percent, compact notation …), e.g. a currency format with "EUR".

props.name: decimals
props.doc: Fixed decimals (shortcut for minimum/maximumFractionDigits).

props.name: mode
props.doc: `count`: the number counts (default) · `roll`: each digit rolls like an odometer · `none`: the value just changes.

props.name: duration
props.doc: ms (default 1600 for count, 900 for roll).

props.name: easing
props.doc: Easing of the count (a motion easing name or token, default "expo").

props.name: start
props.doc: Start when visible (default) or at once.

hadi-march/landing#Counter.tr: Sayaç: `<Counter value={12500} />`, `<Counter value={$price} mode="roll" format={EUR} />` (format: Intl.NumberFormat seçenekleri).

hadi-march/landing#CtaBand.name: CtaBand
hadi-march/landing#CtaBand.doc: `<CtaBand title="Ready to build?" lead="…" actions={[{ label: "Start free", href: "/start" }]} variant="gradient" />`

props.name: video
props.type: { src: string; poster?: string | undefined } | undefined

props.name: backdrop
props.doc: The decorative layers behind the copy (gradient, mesh, glass, grid, pointer light): default true; false: a bare panel.

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the panel when it scrolls into view (default "scale"): a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none".

hadi-march/landing#CtaBand.tr: Çağrı bandı: `<CtaBand title="…" lead="…" actions={[{ label: "Başla", href: "/start" }]} variant="gradient" />`.

hadi-march/landing#Faq.name: Faq
hadi-march/landing#Faq.doc: `<Faq items={[{ q: "Is it free?", a: "Yes, MIT." }]} layout="split" title="Questions" search />`

props.name: title
props.doc: split: heading, lead and a contact line beside the questions.

props.name: search
props.doc: Search box above the questions.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Several open at once (default false).

props.name: labels
props.type: { /** Placeholder and accessible name of the search box (default "Search questions"). */ search?: string; count?: (shown: number, total: number) => unknown; /** Shown when no question matches. */ empty?: unknown; } | undefined
props.doc: Every text the block writes itself; the defaults are translated. `count` gets the shown and the total number.

props.name: count
props.doc: The "3 of 12 questions" line under the search box (default true).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: split: entrance of the heading column (default "up"): a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none".

hadi-march/landing#Faq.tr: Sık sorulan sorular: `<Faq items={[{ q: "Ücretsiz mi?", a: "Evet, MIT." }]} layout="split" title="Sorular" search />`.

hadi-march/landing#FeatureGrid.name: FeatureGrid
hadi-march/landing#FeatureGrid.doc: `<FeatureGrid items={[{ icon: zap, title: "Fast", body: "…" }]} variant="cards" cols={3} />`

props.name: cols
props.doc: Columns (cards / plain: 2–4, default 3).

props.name: spotlight
props.doc: Pointer light on cards and bento tiles (default true).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance (default "up"): a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none" to switch it off.

hadi-march/landing#FeatureGrid.tr: Özellik ızgarası: `<FeatureGrid items={[{ icon: zap, title: "Hızlı", body: "…" }]} variant="cards" cols={3} />`.

hadi-march/landing#FEED_ENTER.name: FEED_ENTER
hadi-march/landing#FEED_ENTER.doc: Enter presets of LiveFeed: name → keyframes, duration and easing for a new item.
hadi-march/landing#FEED_ENTER.tr: LiveFeed geliş animasyonları: flip, slide, fade, pop, drop, zoom, blur, swing, unfold, glide, spin.

hadi-march/landing#FEED_LEAVE.name: FEED_LEAVE
hadi-march/landing#FEED_LEAVE.doc: Leave presets of LiveFeed: name → keyframes, duration and easing for the item that leaves.
hadi-march/landing#FEED_LEAVE.tr: LiveFeed gidiş animasyonları: blur, fade, shrink, fall, slide, dissolve, fold.

hadi-march/landing#Hero.name: Hero
hadi-march/landing#Hero.doc: `<Hero variant="mesh" eyebrow="New" title="Build faster" highlight="faster" lead="…" actions={[{ label: "Start", href: "/start" }]} />`

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Small pill above the title ("New: …").

props.name: eyebrowHref
props.doc: Makes the eyebrow a link.

props.name: eyebrowArrow
props.doc: The arrow after a linked eyebrow: true (default "→"), false, or your own node.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Part of a string title drawn with the brand gradient.

props.name: note
props.doc: Small text under the actions ("No card needed").

props.name: media
props.doc: split / product: an image (size reserved) or any node.

props.name: video
props.type: { src: string; poster?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: video variant.

props.name: layers
props.doc: parallax variant.

props.name: colors
props.doc: Aurora colours (theme tokens by default).

props.name: size
props.doc: md · lg (default) · screen (fills the viewport).

props.name: level
props.doc: Heading level of the title (default 1: the page title; 2 when the hero is not the top of the page).

props.name: backdrop
props.doc: The decorative layers of the variant (grid, mesh, aurora, dots, pointer light, grain): default true; false: none.

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the copy (default "up") and of the split media: a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none".

props.name: frameBar
props.doc: product: the window bar with three dots on the frame (default true).

props.name: tilt
props.doc: product: the frame starts tilted and flattens as you scroll (default true).

hadi-march/landing#Hero.tr: Açılış bölümü: `<Hero variant="mesh" eyebrow="Yeni" title="Daha hızlı kur" highlight="hızlı" lead="…" actions={[…]} />`.

hadi-march/landing#HonestCompare.name: HonestCompare
hadi-march/landing#HonestCompare.doc: `<HonestCompare columns={[{ id: "us", name: "HADİ" }, { id: "a", name: "Other" }]} rows={[{ label: "Offline", values: { us: false, a: true }, note: "Planned for spring" }]} />`

props.name: columns
props.doc: Columns; the one with id `us` is highlighted and scored against the others.

props.name: us
props.doc: Id of the product's own column (default "us").

props.name: caption
props.doc: Table caption (screen readers; shown when `showCaption`).

props.name: summary
props.doc: Show the ahead / even / behind summary and the "only where we are behind" toggle (default true).

props.name: filter
props.doc: The "only where we are behind" toggle in the summary (default true).

props.name: tags
props.doc: The "Ahead" / "Behind" tags beside the row labels (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { yes?: unknown; no?: unknown; partly?: unknown; ahead?: unknown; behind?: unknown; /** Accessible name of the scrolling region (default "Comparison table"). */ region?: string; counts?: (counts: { ahead: number; even: number; behind: number }) => unknown; onlyBehind?: unknown; showAll?: unknown; } | undefined
props.doc: Every text the table writes itself; the defaults are translated. `counts` gets the three numbers.

props.name: renderCell
props.type: ((value: CompareValue, info: { row: CompareRow; column: CompareColumn; us: boolean; verdict: 1 | 0 | -1 | null }) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Draw a cell yourself: return content, or undefined to keep the default mark. `info.us`: the product's own column; `info.verdict`: how the row scores (1 ahead, 0 even, -1 behind, null not scored).

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the product's own column (default: the accent).

hadi-march/landing#HonestCompare.tr: Geride kalınan yerleri de gösteren karşılaştırma tablosu: `<HonestCompare columns={[{ id: "us", name: "HADİ" }, …]} rows={[…]} />`.

props.name: panel
props.doc: Panel width (CSS length, default min(80vw, 32rem)).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the region.

props.name: progress
props.doc: The progress line under the panels (default true).

props.name: pinned
props.doc: Pin the section and move the panels with the page scroll (default true); false: always a native sideways scroller with snap points.

hadi-march/landing#LiveCounter.name: LiveCounter
hadi-march/landing#LiveCounter.doc: `<LiveCounter value={$online} label="people online" />`, `<LiveCounter from={12840} rate={30} effect={splitFlap} dotColor="brand-orange" />`

props.name: value
props.doc: The live value (a signal or accessor fed by your data).

props.name: from
props.doc: First value when the counter simulates growth with `rate`.

props.name: rate
props.doc: Average increase per minute (simulated growth when no `value` is given).

props.name: pause
props.doc: Shortest and longest pause between simulated steps, ms (default [1500, 4500]).

props.name: label
props.doc: What is counted: "people online".

props.name: format
props.doc: Intl.NumberFormat options.

props.name: effect
props.doc: How the digits change: "roll" (odometer, default), "none", or a text animation (`effect={scramble}`).

props.name: effectOptions
props.doc: Options for the text animation (`{ duration: 800 }`); a counting one also gets `start`: the previous value.

props.name: dot
props.doc: The live dot: true (default), false, or your own node.

props.name: dotColor
props.doc: Colour of the dot and its pulse (default: success).

props.name: bubble
props.type: boolean | ((diff: number, text: string) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The "+N" bubble on every increase: true (default), false, or `(diff, text) => content`.

props.name: bubbleColor
props.doc: Colour of the bubble (default: success).

props.name: beat
props.doc: The number beats once on every increase (default true).

props.name: random
props.doc: Random source for the simulated steps (tests).

hadi-march/landing#LiveCounter.tr: Canlı sayaç: `<LiveCounter value={$çevrimiçi} label="kişi şu an" />` ya da `from` + `rate` (dakikada artış) ile ekrandayken büyür.

hadi-march/landing#LiveFeed.name: LiveFeed
hadi-march/landing#LiveFeed.doc: `<LiveFeed next={() => pick(pool)} every={2000} />`, `<LiveFeed items={$events} max={6} variant="wall" />`

props.name: items
props.doc: The items, newest first (reactive: a new first item slides in).

props.name: next
props.doc: Pull one new item; called every `every` ms while the feed is visible and not paused.

props.name: every
props.doc: ms between `next()` calls (default 2400).

props.name: first
props.doc: ms before the first `next()` call (default: `every`); a short one shows the motion at once.

props.name: max
props.doc: Items kept on screen (default 5).

props.name: variant
props.doc: `list` (default): rows, newest on top · `wall`: a grid of cards.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the feed (default "Live activity").

props.name: live
props.doc: Announce new items to screen readers (default "off").

props.name: pausable
props.doc: Show the pause button (default true).

props.name: pauseLabel
props.doc: Text of the pause button while the feed runs (default "Live · pause").

props.name: resumeLabel
props.doc: Text of the pause button while the feed is paused (default "Paused · resume").

props.name: pulse
props.doc: The pulsing dot in the pause button (default true).

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.doc: Pause while the pointer or keyboard focus is inside the feed (default true).

props.name: renderItem
props.doc: Draw an item yourself: the content of its row / card (the feed keeps the list item, its motion and the glow).

props.name: enter
props.doc: How a new item arrives: flip (default), slide, fade, pop, drop, zoom, blur, swing, unfold, glide, spin, "none", or your own keyframes.

props.name: leave
props.doc: How the oldest item leaves: blur (default), fade, shrink, fall, slide, dissolve, fold, "none", or your own keyframes.

props.name: glow
props.doc: Accent ring that glows around a new item and fades (default true).

props.name: move
props.doc: The others glide to their new place (default true); false: they jump.

hadi-march/landing#LiveFeed.tr: Canlı akış: `<LiveFeed next={() => yeniEtkinlik()} every={2400} />` ya da `items={$akış}`; yeni öğe kayarak gelir, üstüne gelince ve düğmeyle durur.

hadi-march/landing#LogoCloud.name: LogoCloud
hadi-march/landing#LogoCloud.doc: `<LogoCloud title="Trusted by" logos={[{ name: "HADİ", src: "/hadi.svg", width: 120, height: 32 }]} variant="marquee" />`

props.name: title
props.doc: Small heading above ("Trusted by teams at").

props.name: mono
props.doc: One muted tone, full colour on hover (default true).

props.name: speed
props.doc: Marquee speed, px/s (default 40).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: grid: entrance of the cells (default "fade"): a Reveal effect, your own `{ from, to }`, or "none".

hadi-march/landing#LogoCloud.tr: Logo bulutu: `<LogoCloud title="Güvenenler" logos={[{ name: "HADİ", src: "/hadiMarka.svg", width: 120, height: 32 }]} variant="marquee" />`.

hadi-march/landing#Newsletter.name: Newsletter
hadi-march/landing#Newsletter.doc: `<Newsletter title="Stay in the loop" onSubmit={(email) => api.subscribe(email)} note="No spam." />`

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Save the address; throw (or reject) to show an error.

props.name: button
props.doc: Button text (default "Subscribe").

props.name: note
props.doc: Small print under the form (privacy note).

props.name: done
props.doc: Shown after success (default "Thanks! Check your inbox.").

props.name: labels
props.type: { /** Accessible name of the field (default "Email address"). */ email?: string; /** Message for an address that is not valid. */ invalid?: string; /** Message when `onSubmit` fails without a message of its own. */ error?: string; } | undefined
props.doc: The other texts the form writes itself; the defaults are translated.

props.name: doneIcon
props.doc: The check mark of the success line: true (default), false, or your own node.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The shake on an error and the fold / pop on success (default true); false: the states just change.

hadi-march/landing#Newsletter.tr: Bülten kaydı: `<Newsletter title="Haberdar ol" onSubmit={(email) => api.subscribe(email)} note="Spam yok." />`.

hadi-march/landing#NotForYou.name: NotForYou
hadi-march/landing#NotForYou.doc: `<NotForYou check items={[{ text: "You need offline sync", detail: "…" }]} forYou={[…]} />`

props.name: items
props.doc: Who it is not for.

props.name: forYou
props.doc: Who it is for (shown beside, with check marks).

props.name: title
props.doc: Heading of the "not for you" list (default "Not for you if…"); false: no heading.

props.name: forYouTitle
props.doc: Heading of the "for you" list (default "For you if…"); false: no heading.

props.name: check
props.doc: Let the visitor strike out the lines that are not them, and show a verdict.

props.name: verdict
props.type: ((n: number, total: number) => unknown) | false | undefined
props.doc: The verdict text for `n` struck-out lines of `total` (default: a prompt, then how many still apply); false: no verdict line.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `cards` (default) · `list`: plain lines with a rule between them.

props.name: onCheck
props.doc: Called with the indexes of the struck-out lines.

props.name: meLabel
props.doc: The label on every checkable card (default "That's me"); false: no label.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Small text under the label before a tap (default "Not you? Tap it!"); false: none.

props.name: markedHint
props.doc: Small text under the label after a tap (default "Not you"): e.g. "You belong here"; false: none.

props.name: mark
props.type: boolean | ((state: "not" | "marked" | "for", item: NotForYouItem, index: number) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The round marks: true (default: a cross, a tick on the "for you" lines and on a struck-out line), false (none), or `(state, item, index) => content` with state "not" (applies), "marked" (struck out) or "for" (the for-you list).

hadi-march/landing#NotForYou.tr: Anti-landing bloğu: `<NotForYou check items={[{ text: "Büyük konferans düzenliyorsun" }]} forYou={[…]} />`; uymayanların üstü çizilir, dürüst sonuç gösterilir.

hadi-march/landing#notForYouVerdict.name: notForYouVerdict
hadi-march/landing#notForYouVerdict.doc: Default verdict for `n` struck-out lines of `total`: a prompt, all ruled out, or how many still apply.
hadi-march/landing#notForYouVerdict.signature: function notForYouVerdict(n: number, total: number): string
hadi-march/landing#notForYouVerdict.tr: NotForYou'nun varsayılan sonuç cümlesi: üstü çizilen satır sayısına göre yönlendirme, kaç maddenin hâlâ uyduğu ya da hiçbirinin uymadığı.

hadi-march/landing#Parallax.name: Parallax
hadi-march/landing#Parallax.doc: `<Parallax layers={[{ src: "/sky.jpg", speed: .5 }, { src: "/hills.png", speed: .25 }, { content: <Logo/>, speed: -.1 }]} pointer={1}>…</Parallax>`

props.name: pointer
props.doc: Follow the mouse too (strength multiplier, default 0 = off).

props.name: height
props.doc: Minimum height (CSS length, default 26rem).

hadi-march/landing#Parallax.tr: Parallax katmanları: `<Parallax layers={[{ src: "/sky.jpg", speed: .5 }, { content: <Logo/>, speed: -.1 }]} pointer={1}>…</Parallax>`.

props.name: index
props.doc: Current slide, 0-based. With `setIndex` it is controlled (`bind:index`, e.g. a URL query parameter).

props.name: transition
props.type: "slide" | "fade" | "zoom" | "none" | ((incoming: HTMLElement, outgoing: HTMLElement | undefined, direction: 1 | -1) => void) | undefined
props.doc: How slides change: a ready one, "none", or your own `(incoming, outgoing, direction) => void` (direction 1 = forward; RTL already applied).

props.name: presenter
props.doc: Show the speaker view (current, next, notes, timer).

props.name: sync
props.doc: Keep windows of this deck in step (the speaker window and the audience). Default "deck".

props.name: presenterUrl
props.doc: URL the speaker button opens in a new window (a page rendering this deck with `presenter`).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the deck.

props.name: controls
props.doc: The control row under the stage (default true).

props.name: counter
props.type: boolean | ((index: number, total: number) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The "Slide 3 of 12" counter: true (default), false, or `(index, total) => content` (index is 0-based).

props.name: progress
props.doc: The progress line under the stage (default true).

props.name: progressColor
props.doc: Colour of the progress line (default: the brand gradient).

props.name: fullscreen
props.doc: The full screen button and the `F` key (default true).

props.name: timer
props.doc: The timer of the speaker view (default true).

props.name: icons
props.type: { previous?: unknown; next?: unknown; speaker?: unknown; fullscreen?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Own icons for the buttons (an icon definition or a node).

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: string | undefined; next?: string | undefined; speaker?: string | undefined; fullscreen?: string | undefined; /** Accessible name of the previous / counter / next group (default "Slides"). */ pages?: string | undefined; /** Text of the counter (index is 0-based). */ counter?: ((index: number, total: number) => string) | undefined; /** aria-roledescription of the deck ("slide deck"). */ deck?: string | undefined; speakerView?: string | undefined; upNext?: string | undefined; end?: string | undefined; notes?: string | undefined; noNotes?: string | undefined; elapsed?: string | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; every one defaults to the built-in translated text.

hadi-march/landing#Pricing.name: Pricing
hadi-march/landing#Pricing.doc: `<Pricing plans={[{ name: "Pro", price: { monthly: 29, yearly: 24 }, features: ["…"], cta: { label: "Start" }, featured: true }]} saving="2 months free" />`

props.name: period
props.doc: Current period (default monthly); with `setPeriod` it is controlled (`bind:period`).

props.name: toggle
props.doc: Hide the switch (one period only).

props.name: currency
props.doc: ISO currency (default EUR).

props.name: saving
props.doc: Next to "Yearly" ("2 months free").

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the featured plan (border, glow, button, badge). Default: the brand gradient and the accent.

props.name: featureIcon
props.doc: The mark in front of a feature: true (default: a tick or a dash), false, or `(included) => node`.

props.name: featureColor
props.doc: Colour of the tick of an included feature (default: success).

props.name: per
props.doc: The "/ month · billed yearly" lines next to the price (default true).

props.name: priceEffect
props.doc: How a price changes with the period: "roll" (odometer, default), "count", or "none" (plain text).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the cards: Reveal options, or false for none (default: up, one after another).

props.name: labels
props.type: { monthly?: unknown; yearly?: unknown; perMonth?: unknown; billedMonthly?: unknown; billedYearly?: unknown; custom?: unknown; /** Accessible name of the switch. */ billingPeriod?: string | undefined; /** Read by screen readers after a feature that is not included. */ notIncluded?: string | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; every one defaults to the built-in translated text.

hadi-march/landing#Pricing.tr: Fiyat tablosu: `<Pricing plans={[{ name: "Pro", price: { monthly: 29, yearly: 24 }, features: ["…"], featured: true }]} saving="2 ay bedava" />`.

hadi-march/landing#ProjectDetail.name: ProjectDetail
hadi-march/landing#ProjectDetail.doc: `<ProjectDetail project={p} onBack={() => $open = null} next={{ project: n, onOpen }} />`

props.name: onBack
props.doc: Back to the list (shows the back button).

props.name: next
props.type: { project: Project; onOpen: (p: Project, cover: Element) => void } | undefined
props.doc: The next project (a card at the end).

props.name: shared
props.doc: Shared element name of the cover (default `project-<id>`, the name ProjectGrid gives its covers).

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: The category line above the title (default true).

props.name: facts
props.doc: The facts list (role, client, year, category; default true).

props.name: backIcon
props.doc: Icon of the back button: an icon, or false for none (default: an arrow).

props.name: nextIcon
props.doc: Icon after the next project's title: an icon or a node, or false for none (default: an arrow).

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the category line (default: the accent).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the heading and the story: Reveal options, or false for none.

props.name: labels
props.type: { back?: unknown; next?: unknown; role?: unknown; client?: unknown; year?: unknown; category?: unknown; /** Accessible name of the services list. */ services?: string | undefined; /** Accessible name of a gallery image (n starts at 1). */ openImage?: ((n: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; every one defaults to the built-in translated text.

hadi-march/landing#ProjectDetail.tr: Proje ayrıntısı: `<ProjectDetail project={p} onBack={() => $open = null} next={{ project: n, onOpen }} />`.

hadi-march/landing#ProjectGrid.name: ProjectGrid
hadi-march/landing#ProjectGrid.doc: `<ProjectGrid projects={work} onOpen={(p, cover) => sharedTransition(`project-${p.id}`, cover, () => $open = p)} />`

props.name: filters
props.doc: Filter chips from the categories (default true when there are two or more).

props.name: cols
props.doc: Columns on wide screens (default 3).

props.name: onOpen
props.doc: Open a project: receives the cover element (start of a shared element transition).

props.name: lightbox
props.doc: Without onOpen: show the cover in the Lightbox (default true).

props.name: allLabel
props.doc: Text of the "all" chip (default "All").

props.name: filtersLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the filter group (default "Filter projects").

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the selected filter chip (default: the accent).

props.name: arrow
props.doc: The arrow badge on a cover: true (default), false, or `(project) => node`.

props.name: motion
props.doc: Animate the filter change (fade out, glide, default true); false swaps the cards at once.

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the cards: Reveal options, or false for none (default: up, one after another).

hadi-march/landing#ProjectGrid.tr: Proje ızgarası; kapak paylaşılan geçişle ayrıntıya dönüşür: `<ProjectGrid projects={work} onOpen={(p, cover) => …} />`.

props.name: effect
props.type: RevealEffect | "none" | { from: Record<string, string | number>; to: Record<string, string | number> } | undefined
props.doc: A ready effect, "none" (the content is simply there), or your own start and end state: `{ from: { opacity: 0, transform: "rotate(-8deg)" }, to: { opacity: 1, transform: "rotate(0deg)" } }`.

props.name: easing
props.doc: Easing of the entrance (a motion engine easing name or a CSS easing; default "expo").

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Delay between children, ms (0 = the whole block at once). Default 70.

props.name: distance
props.doc: Distance for up / down / start / end, px (default 28).

props.name: scrub
props.doc: Follow the scroll (0 → 1 while the block enters the viewport) instead of playing once.

props.name: self
props.doc: Animate the element itself instead of its children.

props.name: select
props.doc: Animate the descendants matching this selector instead of the direct children (cards inside a grid).

hadi-march/landing#revealFrames.name: revealFrames
hadi-march/landing#revealFrames.doc: Start and end state of an effect (transform strings, opacity, filter).
hadi-march/landing#revealFrames.signature: function revealFrames(effect: RevealEffect, distance: number, isRtl: boolean): { from: Record<string, string | number>; to: Record<string, string | number> }

returns.type: { from: Record<string, string | number>; to: Record<string, string | number> }

hadi-march/landing#revealFrames.tr: Bir efektin başlangıç ve bitiş durumu (transform dizgileri, opaklık, filtre).

hadi-march/landing#revealOnScroll.name: revealOnScroll
hadi-march/landing#revealOnScroll.doc: Reveal an element's children (or the element) when it enters the viewport. Works as an action: `<ul use:reveal={{ effect: "up", stagger: 80 }}>`. Returns stop.
hadi-march/landing#revealOnScroll.signature: function revealOnScroll(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/landing#revealOnScroll.tr: Görünüme girince öğenin alt öğelerini (ya da kendisini) belirtir. Eylem olarak da çalışır: `<ul use:reveal={{ effect: "up", stagger: 80 }}>`. Durdurma işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/landing#Roadmap.name: Roadmap
hadi-march/landing#Roadmap.doc: `<Roadmap items={[{ time: "2025 Q1", title: "Launch", status: "done" }, { time: "Q3", title: "Teams", status: "now" }]} />`

props.name: badges
props.type: boolean | ((status: RoadmapStatus, text: unknown) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The status badge next to each title: true (default), false, or `(status, text) => node`.

props.name: scroll
props.doc: Fill the line with the scroll (default true).

props.name: rail
props.doc: The line with its fill (default true); false leaves the dots only.

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the fill and of the dots it has passed (default: the brand gradient and the accent).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Texts of the statuses (defaults: "Done", "In progress", "Planned").

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the entries: Reveal options, or false for none (default: from the start, one after another).

hadi-march/landing#Roadmap.tr: Yol haritası zaman çizelgesi: `<Roadmap items={[{ time: "2025 Ç1", title: "Çıkış", status: "done" }]} />`.

props.name: target
props.doc: Measure this element (an article) instead of the whole page.

props.name: position
props.doc: fixed (top of the viewport, default) or inline.

props.name: paint
props.doc: gradient (brand colours, default) or accent.

props.name: size
props.doc: Bar height in px (default 3).

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the fill (a theme token); wins over `paint`.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Reading progress").

hadi-march/landing#ScrollStory.name: ScrollStory

props.name: side
props.doc: Media column side (default end).

props.name: theme
props.doc: Tint the section with the active step's colour (default true).

props.name: onStep
props.doc: Called when the active step changes.

props.name: dots
props.doc: The dots under the pinned picture (default true).

props.name: numbers
props.doc: The step number above each title: true (default: "01"), false, or `(index) => node`.

props.name: transition
props.type: "rise" | "fade" | "none" | ((incoming: HTMLElement, outgoing: HTMLElement | undefined, direction: 1 | -1) => void) | undefined
props.doc: How the pinned picture changes: "rise" (default), "fade", "none", or your own `(incoming, outgoing, direction) => void` (direction 1 = scrolling down).

hadi-march/landing#ScrollStory.tr: Kaydırmalı anlatı: `<ScrollStory steps={[{ title: "Planla", body: "…", media: <Chart/>, color: "brand-blue" }]} />`.

hadi-march/landing#sectionActions.name: sectionActions
hadi-march/landing#sectionActions.doc: Buttons for a list of actions; nodes pass through. `size` follows the head (lg for lg / xl heads).
hadi-march/landing#sectionActions.signature: function sectionActions(actions: readonly (SectionAction | Node)[] | Node | undefined, size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"): unknown[]
hadi-march/landing#sectionActions.tr: Eylem nesnelerinden (`{ label, href }`) düğmeler üretir; düğümler olduğu gibi geçer. İlki birincil, ötekiler ikincil düğmedir.

hadi-march/landing#SectionHead.name: SectionHead
hadi-march/landing#SectionHead.doc: `<SectionHead eyebrow="Features" title="Everything you need" lead="…" actions={[{ label: "Start", href: "/start" }]} note="No card needed" />`

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Small line above the title: text (uppercase, accent colour) or your own node (a Badge, a pill).

props.name: eyebrowHref
props.doc: Makes the eyebrow a link.

props.name: as
props.doc: Heading element of the title (default "h2").

props.name: titleId
props.doc: Id of the title (aria-labelledby of the section).

props.name: lead
props.doc: Paragraph under the title.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Buttons under the lead: action objects (`{ label, href }`), your own nodes, or both.

props.name: note
props.doc: Small text under the actions ("No card needed").

props.name: align
props.doc: start · center (default) · end.

props.name: size
props.doc: Scale of the title: sm (a card, a form) · md (a section, default) · lg (a call to action) · xl (a hero).

props.name: width
props.doc: Width of the block: "text" (a readable measure, default) or "full".

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the eyebrow (default: the accent).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance when the block scrolls into view: true (parts rise one after another), Reveal options, or false (default).

props.name: children
props.doc: More content under the note.

hadi-march/landing#SectionHead.tr: Sayfa bölümünün başlık grubu: üst etiket, başlık, açıklama, eylemler ve not; hizalama, başlık düzeyi (`as`), ölçek ve isteğe bağlı giriş hareketi. `<SectionHead eyebrow="Özellikler" title="İhtiyacın olan her şey" lead="…" />`.

hadi-march/landing#SiteFooter.name: SiteFooter
hadi-march/landing#SiteFooter.doc: `<SiteFooter brand={{ name: "HADİ" }} columns={[{ title: "Product", links: [{ label: "Pricing", href: "/pricing" }] }]} />`

props.name: copyright
props.doc: Bottom start (default "© <year> <brand name>"); false for none.

props.name: wordmark
props.doc: A large wordmark across the bottom (text or your own node).

props.name: toTop
props.doc: "Back to top" button (default true).

props.name: toTopIcon
props.doc: Icon of the "back to top" button (default: an arrow up).

props.name: toTopLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the "back to top" button (default "Back to top").

hadi-march/landing#SiteFooter.tr: Site altbilgisi: `<SiteFooter brand={{ name: "HADİ" }} columns={[{ title: "Ürün", links: [{ label: "Fiyatlar", href: "/pricing" }] }]} />`.
